$comment: Hooks that turn Claude Code's own lifecycle into organisation events. ★ THE SCRIPT IS NOT IN THIS REPOSITORY. It lives in vimlendu-maker/swechha-ai and is reached through ~/.swechha-ai/hook-event.py, a symlink. That indirection is an INTERFACE, and it earned itself on 2026-09-11: the script moved out of this repository into the org repo and this file did not change by a character. The path is absolute because a session's working directory is not reliably this repository — CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR was unset here and a relative path resolved into an unrelated project. Every command ends `; exit 0`: a failing hook surfaces as a BLOCKING error on the tool call it was meant to be silently recording, so telemetry must never stop the work. sentinel/hooks-health.sh in swechha-ai watches that this stays wired, every 30 minutes.
